en: The image is a black-and-white aerial photograph, likely from an older era, showing a large river or bay surrounded by land, with a town or city visible on the right bank. There are signs of industrial or port activity, including what appear to be timber rafts or lumber floating in the water, a classic feature of historic Swedish river cities. Hills and forested land are in the background. The lower part of the image contains some printed text.
